strengths.label: Strength
strengths.text: The paper studies an important and timely problem. The proposed dataset is carefully constructed and the annotation guidelines are clearly documented.

quotes.label: Weakness
quotes.text: The evaluation uses only two baselines, both from 2023. It is unclear whether the gains hold against more recent methods.

quotes.label: Question
quotes.text: Could the authors compare against at least one recent baseline?

quotes.label: Weakness
quotes.text: The ablation in Section 5 removes components one at a time, but never tests them together.

quotes.label: Question
quotes.text: How sensitive are the results to the choice of random seed?

strengths.label: Strength
strengths.text: The writing is clear and the figures are easy to follow. I appreciate that the authors release code and data.

quotes.label: Weakness
quotes.text: The human study has only 12 participants, which limits the strength of the conclusions.

quotes.label: Weakness
quotes.text: There are several typos, e.g. "dataest" in Table 2.
